probe.geometry_basis: FFprobe coded video dimensions; FFmpeg autorotation is disabled

config.dark_roi_threshold: median + 8 * (1.4826 * MAD), floor 50 pixels with luma > 100

limitations: Screening uses scaled RGB heuristics and does not replace full-resolution perceptual review.
The scan does not establish human review, listening, or device playback acceptance.
A frame with no heuristic flags may still contain visual defects outside these checks.
